designationHistory.name: Upper Mississippi River Wild Life and Fish Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Congress established the Upper Mississippi River Wild Life and Fish Refuge by the Upper Mississippi River Wild Life and Fish Refuge Act, approved June 7, 1924.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (2006 CCP: established by an act of Congress on June 7, 1924) and Pass B (U.S. Code source credit for the act: June 7, 1924, ch. 346, 43 Stat. 650) agree. The act made land acquisition depend on consent of the four state legislatures. Name affirmed as Upper Mississippi River National Wildlife and Fish Refuge by Public Law 105-312 (1998).
